Entry Ghost Grass and Dangerous Flora Ghostweed, poison hemlock, poppy and other rare plants from all over the world have their place in pharmacopoeias and folk tales. Maesters differentiate between dosage and use, assassins and desperadoes concern themselves with the more dangerous parts; the same grass can be analgesic, a hallucinogen, and can make a death seem providential. Altars, relics, and prophecies can unite people and give a political claim the appearance of irrefutability.

Entry Ghost Grass and Dangerous Flora Ghostweed, poison hemlock, poppy and other rare plants from all over the world have their place in pharmacopoeias and folk tales. Maesters differentiate between dosage and use, assassins and desperadoes concern themselves with the more dangerous parts; the same grass can be analgesic, a hallucinogen, and can make a death seem providential. Some people use it as a talisman, while others use it as the name of fear; the same prayer may make people draw their swords or put them down.

Maesters differentiate between dosage and use, assassins and desperadoes concern themselves with the more dangerous parts; the same grass can be analgesic, a hallucinogen, and can make a death seem providential. Whether the gods responded or not could not be proven by the account books, but how the rituals were held and who could interpret the omens actually determined the authority of the community.
